remarks: Set high on a quiet cul-de-sac, 2 Wahackme Lane is a gracious single family home in New Canaan that offers privacy, space, and a beautiful natural setting. Overlooking rolling greenery and expansive outdoor play areas, this property sits on 2.9 acres and is designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The home features 5 bedrooms, (the 5th bedroom with full bath is on the first floor and is an optional home office) 4 full baths and 2 half, with thoughtful details throughout, including 3 fireplaces and a charming screened porch off the dining room-ideal for summer evenings. The oversized kitchen is the heart of the home, complete with an eat-in area and an adjoining family room. French doors open to a sunny terrace, creating a seamless flow for outdoor dining. Upstairs you will find 4 bedrooms,3 full baths, a convenient laundry room, and an oversized great room, offering flexible space for recreation, homework, or quiet retreat. Perfectly located just minutes from Irwin Park, downtown New Canaan, and West School. This hilltop retreat combines a serene setting with easy access to town amenities, making it an exceptional place to call home.
